Override.AttributionNote: an unnamed Chan practitioner from Jiahe is the exact actor. Drafts from Chan Master Weilin Daopei's Traveling Hermitage (為霖禪師旅泊菴稿), Weilin Daopei's preface to Daqian's recorded sayings. The exact grammatical actor is the Chan practitioner identified only as being from Jiahe: Weilin says that this practitioner had long trained under the hammer and whisk, cherished the record, and spread it widely. All six rungs supply no personal name for him.
